title: Joseph'ly Optimised
description: THE MOST performant Modpack (according to me)
body:
# ⚡ Joseph'ly Optimised

Joseph'ly Optimised is a hyper-focused, lightweight modpack built to deliver the absolute maximum performance for Minecraft. By removing bloated features and grouping the best modern optimization mods, it transforms your game into a smooth, high-FPS experience without sacrificing the core vanilla feel.

## 🌟 Key Features

Insane FPS Boosts: Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore to reduce RAM usage and maximize frame rates. 

Zero-Lag Chunk Loading: Uses Bobby and Cull Leaves for massive render distances with zero stutter.

Instant Load Times: ModernFix and FastQuit eliminate loading screen freezes and let you save and exit instantly.

Smoother Multiplayer: Optimized network traffic with Krypton and Very Many Players for low-latency gameplay.

Shader Support: Built-in Iris shader compatibility so you can play beautifully without the lag.

Drop this pack into your launcher and experience Minecraft at its absolute fastest!
